The spec has the gate run and only withholds the record (Test Strategy: "gate runs over an uncommitted product edit ... no record from that run"; Risks: a project that does not ignore docs/dev/tmp "fails safe (a rerun)").
reason: The PRD is self-contradictory here: Feature "Sole writer" line 70 specifies `run_gate` "checks before spawning and after reaping", which is exactly the implemented early return, and success metric line 58 ("A gate run on a tree dirty outside the store never yields a record") is satisfied by it. Only the Edge case wording on line 247 implies the gate still runs. Simplest safe reading kept: the early return stands, because spawning a full suite whose result can never be recorded is pure waste. The practical consequence Blake reproduced is the non-hermetic fixture, which IS being fixed this cycle (R4/R11).
